run_image_feature_extraction_pipeline: run the image feature extraction pipeline on a PIL image using a tiny ViT model
test_image_feature_extraction_with_pooli: test the image feature extraction pipeline with pool=True to get pooled features from a model with a pooler
test_image_processor_kwargs: test passing image processor kwargs like image_mean and image_std to the feature extraction pipeline
test_return_tensors: test that the image feature extraction pipeline returns torch tensors when return_tensors=True
run_batch_feature_extraction: run the image feature extraction pipeline on a list of images and verify batch output length
